translations.web: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
translations.bsb: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
translations.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
